Sub:- Compliance Audit of Exempted Establishment. 
Sir, 
Please refer to Head Office letter of even no. dt. 15/10/09 on the above 
subject. 
2. 
The Annexure-Il of the compliance audit report submitted by your office 
has since been compiled in Head Offic,e & the following observations are 
noticed:- 
(i)
A number of establishments have reported Idsses for 3 consecutive 
financial years or are lying closed. (violation of condition no. 25) 
(ii)
Losses occurred to . the P.F trust have not been recouped by the 
employer/establishment. (violation of condition no. 28) 
(iii)
Default in payment of P.F & allied dues (violation of condition nO. 5) 
(iv)
Evasion in membership specially in respect of contract employees. 
(violation of condition no..3) 
(v)
Nony submission of the audited balance sheet by the P.F Trust (violation 
of condition no. 24) 
(vi)
Legal status of the establishment has changed due to merger, demerger;' 
amalgamation etc. (viblation of condition no 29) 
(vii)
No . D-mat account has 6een opened in the name of the trust for 
transacting in securities. (violation of condition no. 18) 
3. 
All the above mentioned violations of the conditions of exemption are 
extremely serious in nature and require immediate actions as prescribed under 
the Act & Scheme, however the replies submitted by your office with regards to 
actions initiated, suggests that only routine letters have been sent in such cases. * 
4.. It reiterated that all RPFCs incharge of the regiont are personally 
responsible for the monitoring of the exempted establishments under their 
jurisdiCtion., Head Office vide its circular no. C-1/Misc,/02/06/ExmNo1.1 dt. 
26/12/08 has very clearly spealt out the actions that need tO be initi ated in cases

s 
( P. Sudhakar 
Additional Central P.F. Commissioner( 
pliance) 
of violations of Condition of exemption. It is therefore directed that all RPFCs 
should immediately initiate necessary, actions mentioned in the Head Office 
circular referred above against all establishments found violating the conditions 
of exemption. 
5.
Your attention is also invited, to Head Office circular no. C-
11/Misc/2/06/EZNo1.1 dt. 04/11/08, wherein it was specified that immediate action 
for cancellation of exemption should be initiated against establishments violating 
condition no. 25 i.e. continuous losses for 3 consecutive years.. You are 
therefore directed that proposals for cancellation of exemption should be 
forwarded to Head, Office as per circular dt. 30/07/09 in respect of all such cases 
within a fortnight, so that appropriate action may be initiated Without any further 
delay. .In respect of relaxed establishments RPFCs may initiate necessary action 
for withdrawal of relaxation at their level immediately. 
I 
' 
• 
6.
You are also directed to initiate enquiries u/s 7A of. the Act whenever 
instances of default or evasion in membership has been detected during the 
compliance audit. It should be ensured that the enquiries are completed in a 
time bound manner as per Head Office directions & the assessed dues are • 
recovered. Further prosecution action u/s 14 should also be invariably launched 
against the employer as well the members of the Board of Trustees in case of 
default in the payment of dues or non- submission of statutory returns. 
7.
Condition No. 6,7,28 of the revised conditions specify that in the event of 
any loss to the trust as a result of any fraud defalcation, wrong investment 
decision etc. or any deficiency in the interest rate as compared to statutory rate, 
the employer shall be liable to make good the loss/interest. You are therefore 
directed to ensure that wherever losses to the trust have been reported, the 
same is made good by the employer/establishment and is not adjusted against • 
previous years surplus/reserves of the trust. 
8.
An Action Taken Report on all the above mentioned points be sUbmitted to 
this office by 14/05/10. 
End: As above 
Copy to:- All Additional Central P.F. Commissioners (Zones) for kind information 
& necessary action.
